therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Proteasome inhibition combined with radioimmunotherapy targeting CD20
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Lymphoma cell apoptosis through proteasome inhibition and targeted radiation delivery to CD20-positive B cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum tolerated dose and tolerability determined by dose limiting toxicities

results.effect_size: MTD established at 1.3 mg/m2 bortezomib (2 DLTs at 1.6 mg/m2)
results.dose_information: Dose escalation: 1.0, 1.3, 1.6 mg/m2 bortezomib on days 1, 8, 15, 22 during induction; consolidation with bortezomib days 1, 8, 15 for maximum 3 cycles

context.duration: Induction 28 days, consolidation up to 3 cycles (approximately 6 months total)
